title: The Time When I Built A FIFA Prediction NFT Raffle
tagline: A Simple NFT Raffle pool to predict Ongoing FIFA World Tournament.
description:

=>Vesting of Emotion - Usage of Dapps.

Thus, this time during the #ETHINDIA Hackathon ***I BUILT A SIMPLE FIFA PREDICTION AND RAFFLE NFT DAPP : [HTTPS://WAGMI.FOOTBALL](HTTPS://WAGMI.FOOTBALL) ***
